name: Minimal Contradictory Rule Subsets
description: Replaces the explicit geometric relaxation scenarios (which directly told the model which vehicles could "overlap freely") with formal subsets of the problem's rules. This removes the textual triggers for simple sum accumulators, forcing the model to logically deduce that applying Bounds + Non-overlapping to a lane implies a sum constraint, and Bounds + Team Ordering to a team implies a pair-sum constraint.
